description: Report to Spicrawl a request that failed in a way you could not fix, or that returned wrong or missing content. Call it once per problem per task, with the request_id of the failed call (from the error text, or the X-Request-Id header) and intent: what you were trying to get. Rate it down (the default) for a problem, up if the result was right. The report is free. A thumbs-down on a charged request refunds its credits, up to a daily cap per account. Never include secrets, API keys or cookies, and keep page content out: a short description is enough.

comment.description: What you saw and what you expected, briefly. No secrets; no page content beyond a short description.

impact.description: blocked: you could not finish the task; worked_around: you found another way; friction: it cost time but did not block.

intent.description: What you were trying to get, in a few words, e.g. 'the prices on the category page'. No secrets.

kind.description: broken: an error or crash; wrong_result: the content was wrong; missing: content was absent; confusing: unclear output; other.

rating.description: down for a problem (the default); up when the result was right.

request_id.description: The request id of the call being reported: from the error text, or the X-Request-Id header.

name: spicrawl_feedback

already_submitted.description: True when this request already had feedback; nothing new was recorded.

feedback_id.description: The id of the recorded feedback.

refund_cap_reached.description: True when the account's daily refund cap is used up.

title: Report a Spicrawl problem
